> Clean by construction: an ordinary launch post, written flat.

Scheduled exports are live today. You pick a report, a frequency and a
destination, and the file arrives without anyone opening the app.

Destinations at launch are email and S3-compatible storage. Two more are in
progress and I am not going to name dates for them, because the last two dates
I named were both wrong by a month.

If you were one of the eleven people who asked for this in the feedback form,
it is your request that got it built. Thank you for being specific about the
file format.
